test.name: Spec 0010 spike: inherited instance.lock flock survives the parent

expected: open(O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC, 0600) plus flock(LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB) gives a lock that a child inherits on fd 3 and keeps after the daemon closes its fd and after the daemon exits, released only when every holder exits (spec 0010 AC-6, AC-9, Adapter macOS row Lock)
actual: The lock file is a regular 0600 file owned by 502 with FD_CLOEXEC on the daemon's fd; a symlinked lock path fails with ELOOP; a second open description in the same process gets EWOULDBLOCK (probe while held reads Held). Child with the lock on fd 3: after the daemon closed its copy, probe_lock reads Held; after the child exits it reads Free. Orphan case: the daemon that spawned the child exited, and probe_lock from the spike reads Held while holds_file shows the inode; Free within 2 s of the orphan's exit. The suspended orphan holds it too. flock(LOCK_UN) on the daemon's copy released the lock while the child that inherited it was still alive, which is why spec 0010 releases with close only. A descendant (`sleep 30 & exit 0` with fd 3) keeps the lock after the main process exited and was reaped. Deleting instance.lock while it is held lets a new file at the same path be locked although the old holder lives, which is why spec 0010 also checks the last observation.
